title: AC1024 AcDbAssocVariable bounded suffix decode

supersedes.scope: The earlier receipt's statement that the mechanical physical body/handle suffix was unclassified. Its output and graph qualification limits remain current.

scope.purpose: Decode the witnessed empty and one-child object suffix forms while retaining unknown marker data and leaving document-level graph output closed.

productionTrace.observation: 17/17 records have parsed fields and complete bounded body/text/handle spans. Four use the empty suffix; thirteen use the one-child suffix.

independentProjection.observation: The absolute-handle join matches all 17 variables: each one-child suffix targets one ASSOCVALUEDEPENDENCY whose ownerhandle is the source variable; empty suffixes have no such owned child. This corroborates the observed role and edge, not application semantics.

wireProfile.empty: One BS(0) body suffix and no object-specific handle.
wireProfile.oneChild: BS(1), followed by BS(0), then one code-3 hard-ownership relative handle. The zero BS is retained as an uninterpreted marker.
wireProfile.padding: The object body must end exactly at its bounded span; the object-handle stream accepts only its bounded byte-alignment padding.
wireProfile.authority: ODA Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1 sections 2.2–2.4 and 20.1 support generic bit-code framing, hard-ownership reference roles, and handle-stream byte alignment. They do not specify the ACDBASSOCVARIABLE class-specific suffix; that profile is limited to the physical witness and independent field/owner correlation above.

implementation.behavior: AC1024 ASSOCVARIABLE retains the bounded owned-dependency references and the observed zero suffix marker. Only the witnessed zero-child and one-child forms are wire-complete; unsupported counts, wrong handle roles, and malformed spans remain partial records. Model copy and reset preserve/clear the added state.

focusedTest.result: PASS 1/1. Generated vectors cover real/int32 values, empty/one-child suffixes, copy/assignment, wrong-role handles, and an unsupported child count. No DWG/DXF fixture was added.

physicalRead.result: The production parser reports zero entity/object parse failures and complete wire status for all 17 ASSOCVARIABLE records. The overall strict conversion still exits 1 because another part of the source read disposition remains incomplete; this receipt does not identify or close that separate blocker and does not establish graph output/readback.

validation.temporaryInstrumentation: Removed after collecting the production trace.

limitations: The implemented physical profile is limited to the AC1024 forms witnessed in the mechanical source; no producer-wide or cross-version guarantee is made.
The suffix marker has no assigned class-level semantic meaning.
Required graph-edge/descendant closure, physical source-to-output binding, emitted-field readback, atomic document publication/retry, and strict complete-export admission remain open.
No external or native consumer support claim is promoted.
